rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for tasteful, elegant clothing, style, or presentation.

example.english: This suit has a simple cut and looks classy.
example.traditional: 呢套西裝剪裁簡潔，睇落好有品味。
example.jyutping: ne1 tou3 sai1 zong1 zin2 coi4 gaan2 git3 tai2 lok6 hou2 jau5 ban2 mei6

rows.note: Use this for a stylish, visually striking look when “classy” leans toward cool and fashionable rather than tasteful.

example.english: Their leather jacket completes the whole look and is really classy.
example.traditional: 佢今日件皮褸襯晒成個造型，真係好有型。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gam1 jat6 gin6 pei2 lau1 can3 saai3 seng4 go3 zou6 jing4 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 jing4

rows.note: Use this for a person or action that shows admirable self-control, decency, or good manners.

example.english: Even after losing the match, they shook hands with their opponent in a classy way.
example.traditional: 就算輸咗場比賽，佢都好有風度咁同對手握手。
example.jyutping: zau6 syun3 syu1 zo2 coeng4 bei2 coi3 keoi5 dou1 hou2 jau5 fung1 dou6 gam3 tung4 deoi3 sau2 ak1 sau2
